name: Achievements Unlock
summary: In-game achievement list with one-click instant unlock buttons
description:
An in-game manager and one-click unlocker for all official achievements.

Features:
1. Top-Left Quick Button: Convenient button in the top-left corner of the game screen to open the achievement window anytime.
2. Complete Achievement List: Real-time overview of all achievements with icons, names, descriptions, and current unlock status.
3. One-Click Unlock: Instantly unlock any individual achievement with a single click.
4. Unlock All: Unlock all remaining achievements in one go.
5. Status Filters: Easily filter achievements by All, Locked, or Unlocked.

zh.name: 成就解鎖器
zh.summary: 遊戲內成就列表視窗，支援一鍵直接解鎖任意或全部成就
zh.description:
專為《Transport Fever 2》打造的成就管理與一鍵解鎖工具。

功能特色：
1. 專屬按鈕：位於遊戲畫面左上角，可隨時點擊開啟成就視窗。
2. 完整成就列表：即時顯示所有官方成就的圖示、名稱、說明與當前解鎖狀態。
3. 一鍵直接解鎖：每個未完成的成就旁均有一鍵解鎖按鈕，按下即可直接達成成就。
4. 全部解鎖功能：提供一鍵解鎖全部剩餘成就功能。
5. 狀態過濾篩選：支援依全部、未解鎖、已解鎖進行分類篩選。
